versions.name: RXV2-0.9.901-bluetooth-reply-resync
versions.notes: Bluetooth update from a phone: an install no longer fails with 'cannot be converted to JSONObject'. The apps read every reply header as a header, so a reply cut short or sent twice can no longer be taken for the body of the next one; the Android app keeps one Bluetooth link only (two made every reply arrive twice) and logs what the link did (Send debug data on the Help page, and a note on a failed install); the receiver's reply pump stops cleanly when a fresh request arrives mid-reply.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.900-rescue-channel
versions.notes: The Rescue page names the rescue switch's channel as the Switches page does: AUX 5 is channel 10, not 9 (AUX 1 is channel 6).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.899-read-black-box-now
versions.notes: Read black box: the Black box page's button now starts the read as the page opens, with a progress bar (how far, how long is left, the flights found so far) and a line saying what it is doing; the What-to-record link waits while a read runs. Over Bluetooth the phone could never start a black box read in 0.9.898: its routes were registered on the WiFi server only, so the app got 'not found'. Fixed, with a gate (dev/route_gate.js) that keeps every route on the router that serves both.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.898-sbus-standard-scale
versions.notes: SBUS output now uses the standard scale (992 = 1500 us), so a flight controller on SBUS reads the same microseconds as on CRSF: centre 1500, not 1519, and full travel. Anyone flying SBUS from an RXV2 should check centre and travel on the receiver tab once.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.897-exact-rates-curves
versions.notes: Rates curves drawn with Rotorflight's own formulas (Shape now counts); Max Vel is the true full-stick speed; the transmitter draws the same curves (B107).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.896-rates-type-start-values
versions.notes: Rates type: a new type gives its starting values (as Rotorflight's Configurator), never a type Rotorflight lacks; the hello wave removed; Receiver settings: a Cells list for the receiver battery.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.895-diff-and-execute
versions.notes: Diff & execute on the phone (Rotorflight > Backup & restore, or A la carte): Diff to phone keeps every Rotorflight setting as text (diff all, as the transmitter's Diff to card); Execute sends a kept diff back to the model and saves. Needs the USB cable.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.894-easy-tuning-moved-only
versions.notes: Easy tuning: a slider you do not move never changes its numbers (moving Cyclic used to round the tail's gains too, and the PID spool-up tick alone rewrote the start settings); a governor choice outside Rotorflight's lists is never written back.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.893-governor-choices-in-range
versions.notes: Governor (global): the throttle type is now chosen from Rotorflight's three (NORMAL, SWITCH, FUNCTION); a value the flight controller holds outside its list shows as not valid and Save waits for a real choice. The receiver never passes an out-of-range governor mode or throttle type on from the transmitter.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.892-hobbywing-program-box
versions.notes: The ESC pages now recommend Hobbywing's LCD program box for a Hobbywing ESC: quick and easy, and well worth having.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.891-save-above-keyboard
versions.notes: Save stays in view while typing: the iPhone page now shrinks above the keyboard, so the floating Save bar sits just over it; Filters and In-flight adjustments get the floating Save bar too.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.890-save-lands
versions.notes: Save while the keyboard is up: the floating Save bar lands in the page flow (at the foot of the page, under Reload) for as long as a box is being typed in and the keyboard covers the window, and floats again when the keyboard goes - it used to step aside, so Save was out of reach until the keyboard was dismissed (Malcolm, the Travel page). Android, whose window shrinks for its keyboard, keeps the bar floating above it.

rotorflight.line: Rotorflight 2.3 — the release these pages are written and tested against.
